# Config: Appearance.surface

> **Reader:** `Appearance` (`config/Appearance.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.Appearance` · category Look & Feel
> **Part of:** [Appearance](Appearance.md)

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.

### `Appearance.surface`

- **`Appearance.surface`** · object
  - Translucency
  - x-scope="look", x-intro="TranslucencyStatus"
- **`Appearance.surface.opacity`** · integer = 100 · 60–100 · %
  - Surface opacity: How solid the shell's surfaces are: bars, the screen border, popouts, menus and panels (not your apps' windows: Compositor → Window look → Window opacity). 100 is fully solid. A translucent surface needs the compositor to blur behind it (Compositor → Window look → Blur).
  - x-enabledIf={"/$supports.blur":true}
  - read: `Appearance.surfaceAlpha` (computed) · in: `shell/BlurBackingWindow.qml`
